source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: _createFolderRow passes compact=true only when _isCompact and that mode canBeCompact are both true. A saved compact flag can remain even when the UI disables compact view for a mode, so the capability check belongs at row creation. Fixed code retains this conjunction. Missing Bug comments6/7 remain an explicit context gap; review approval does not independently establish a runtime cure. No folder-tree test ran.
title: Compact folder rows require both stored state and mode support
